blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Scottsdale. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Scottsdale, North Delta: 41 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 4 North Delta communities for houses.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Scottsdale fell from 54 in June to 41 in October (−24.1%), and 38 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 21.9% of North Delta’s 187 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Scottsdale?
Scottsdale also had 25 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 41 houses listed. The Scottsdale condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Scottsdale is the south-east corner of North Delta in the City of Delta, along Scott Road at the Surrey border. Newton, in Surrey, is across Scott Road to the east.
The grid used here is 72 Avenue south, 84 Avenue north, 112 Street west and Scott Road (120 Street) east. It is a working grid, not an official boundary.
Scottsdale Exchange itself sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road, per the City. A Scottsdale house is in Delta even though its bus exchange is in Surrey.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Detached houses and duplexes on the interior grid are Scottsdale's house stock, with strata towers toward Scott Road and 80 Avenue. Delta's 2024 Official Community Plan (OCP) shows Small Scale Residential and Mixed Residential designations in and around the area.

A Scottsdale duplex can be strata or non-strata, and the title form changes the obligations. The Province states strata housing can include duplexes, with owners holding their strata lot plus a share of common property.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Lots within 400 metres of Scottsdale Exchange sit in a transit-oriented area with minimum densities. Delta states the provincial Bill 47 Transit Oriented Development Area extends 400 metres from the exchange.
A suite, coach house or garden suite can be combined with a house or duplex here under Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules.
Zoning is lot by lot, so two similar houses can carry different expectations. Confirm the lot's zone and any transit-oriented overlay on DeltaMap before pricing development potential.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Chalmers Park is at 11400 76A Avenue, with sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, trails and washrooms listed by the City.
Gunderson Park is at 7630 117 Street, inside the Scottsdale grid. The City lists it at that address.
Scott Road carries the area's through traffic and the R6 RapidBus, so interior streets and Scott Road frontage live differently. TransLink's R6 timetable runs on Scott Road and 72 Avenue.
No recreation centre inside the Scottsdale grid was confirmed.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Named once here: the Scottsdale Exchange transit-oriented area in Delta's 2024 OCP, which sets the density context for house lots near 72 Avenue and Scott Road.
Status: in service, timetable effective April 20, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Delta flat-rate utilities for a single-family home are $1,658 in 2026 — the houses-specific angle is that a Scottsdale house pays the same Delta flat rate as a Nordel house.
Delta property taxes were due July 2, 2026.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: getting around

items.t: The R6 Scott Road RapidBus is Scottsdale's rapid transit link, running from Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange. TransLink lists the R6 among its six RapidBus routes.
Scottsdale Exchange is the local bus hub for the area.
Scott Road Station, at the north end of the R6, connects to the Expo Line SkyTrain. The R6 timetable starts at Scott Road Station.

blocks.text: Scottsdale Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check DeltaMap for the lot before offering.
Check title charges before assuming a rebuild or suite is allowed. Delta's development considerations page states title charges can affect use or redevelopment of a property.

blocks.text: Scottsdale home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

66 houses sold in Scottsdale with a median price of $1,227,500 (the middle half sold between $1,096,250 and $1,368,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 95.7% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $514 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 6,822 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Scottsdale?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 41 houses listed in Scottsdale. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Scottsdale a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Scottsdale had a sales ratio of 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Scottsdale from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 38 houses sold in Scottsdale over those 5 months, out of 154 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Scottsdale?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Scottsdale house?
faq.a: For 7031 120 Street, School District No. 37 (SD37) gave Heath Elementary, 11364 72 Avenue, for Kindergarten to Grade 7 and Seaquam Secondary, 11584 Lyon Road, for Grades 8 to 12. Scottsdale has no middle-school tier in SD37.

faq.q: Does the transit-oriented area change what I can build?
faq.a: Yes, near the exchange it can, because minimum densities apply close to transit. A lot inside that line and a lot just outside it can face different density expectations, so measure the lot against the official area map.

No, the exchange itself is on the Surrey side of Scott Road, per the City of Delta. Scottsdale houses are in Delta and pay Delta taxes and utilities, while the buses at the exchange are TransLink services. Do not rely on a listing's "steps to the exchange" wording without checking the lot's side of Scott Road.

faq.q: Is a Scottsdale duplex always a strata?
faq.a: No, a duplex here may be strata-titled or non-strata, and you must check the title. The Province's strata guidance lists duplexes as a form strata housing can take. A strata duplex has a strata corporation and common property; a non-strata duplex does not, which affects insurance, repairs and financing.

faq.q: What did houses in Scottsdale sell for?
faq.a: 66 houses sold in Scottsdale between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,227,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Scottsdale?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
